why_realistic: datadir.py's own comment says a probe that can fail open is not a check, and its one unreachable-state branch is 'not deployed from a worktree, nothing to be inside of'. A linked worktree or a submodule spells .git as a FILE, so tightening exists() to isdir() routes a perfectly normal checkout into that branch, and the refusal that keeps real run output out of the public tool repo silently permits everything.
oracle:
"""The in-repo refusal must still fire in a checkout whose .git is a FILE.

git spells .git as a directory in a normal clone and as a FILE holding `gitdir: ...` in a linked
worktree and in a submodule. Both are real checkouts of the tool repo. If only the directory form
counts, _own_repo_root answers None on the file form, _reject_if_inside_own_repo takes its
'not deployed from a worktree' branch, and every path is accepted, including one pointing straight
back into the tool repo. That branch is meant for a copy that is not in a worktree at all, and
mapping a real worktree onto it turns the only assertion this file makes into a no-op.
"""
import os

import pytest

import datadir


def _worktree(base, git_is_a_file):
    root = base / "skillrepo"
    (root / "tools").mkdir(parents=True)
    if git_is_a_file:
        (root / ".git").write_text("gitdir: ../mainline/.git/worktrees/skillrepo\n",
                                   encoding="utf-8")
    else:
        (root / ".git").mkdir()
    return root


def _same(a, b):
    return os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(str(a))) == os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(str(b)))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("git_is_a_file", [False, True])
def test_the_repo_root_is_found_for_both_spellings_of_dot_git(tmp_path, monkeypatch,
                                                              git_is_a_file):
    base = tmp_path / ("f" if git_is_a_file else "d")
    root = _worktree(base, git_is_a_file)
    monkeypatch.setattr(datadir, "__file__", str(root / "tools" / "datadir.py"))
    found = datadir._own_repo_root()
    assert found is not None, (
        "a checkout whose .git is a %s was not recognised as a worktree at all"
        % ("file" if git_is_a_file else "directory"))
    assert _same(found, root), "resolved %s, expected %s" % (found, root)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("git_is_a_file", [False, True])
def test_a_data_dir_inside_the_tool_repo_is_refused_for_both_spellings(tmp_path, monkeypatch,
                                                                      git_is_a_file):
    base = tmp_path / ("f" if git_is_a_file else "d")
    root = _worktree(base, git_is_a_file)
    monkeypatch.setattr(datadir, "__file__", str(root / "tools" / "datadir.py"))
    with pytest.raises(datadir.DataDirInsideOwnRepo):
        datadir.assert_outside_own_repo(root / "archive", "daily-hotspots")


def test_the_refusal_is_not_always_on(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Negative control: a path OUTSIDE the repo is still accepted, so the guard is not blanket."""
    base = tmp_path / "n"
    root = _worktree(base, True)
    monkeypatch.setattr(datadir, "__file__", str(root / "tools" / "datadir.py"))
    outside = base / "skillrepo-config" / "data"
    outside.mkdir(parents=True)
    datadir.assert_outside_own_repo(outside, "daily-hotspots")
